conservative.requirements: ~ You must have exhausted your personal supply of fortune points and have just failed a check of Daunting ({Dc}4) difficulty or higher. Effect: When you have exhausted your personal supply of fortune points and just failed a check of Daunting ({Dc}4) difficulty or higher, you may play this card. In your darkest hour, a brilliant twin-tailed comet burns across the sky, bolstering you and your allies. You gain favour equal to your WP, gain 2 fortune points, and you and all your allies (regardless of range) recover 1 wound, 1 fatigue, and 1 stress.
